name: Tiebreak luck
definition: Per match: tiebreaks won minus sum over tiebreaks played of pi_TB(p_i, p_j, L), the iid tiebreak win probability at the two players' own serve-point rates in that match (L = 10 for Slam deciding tiebreaks under the rule, else 7; stage2_iid.tiebreak). Decayed sum over the player's earlier completed box-score matches at every level, weight 2^(-days/91) (secondary 365 d and flat 52 weeks); expectation curves frozen on 2010-2012; A - B; registered sign negative.
mechanism: Tiebreak outcomes are luck (season spread = pure iid spread, 2.28 tiebreaks for men 2013-24) but enter scorelines (straight sets), round reached, rankings and results-based ratings as wins; a 0.02-0.06 log-odds shift is below the margin, so sharps cannot bet it alone and the close keeps it
data_paths: data/studies/predictability_diagnostic/stage0_match_players.parquet (spw_n/d, tb_won_n/d, hold_n/d, brk_n/d, bp_saved_n/d, bp_conv_n/d, games_won_n/d, sets_won_n/d, tpw_n/d); stage0_matches.parquet (score, best_of, status, level, round); data/studies/predictability_diagnostic/stage2_matches.parquet (tb_exp_a, tb_over_a); src/eda/predictability_diagnostic/stage2_iid.py
coverage_note: Both tours, every level with box scores (men CH 99%, WTA125 94%, tour 88-99%, ITF ~10%); stage2_matches has men 2010-26 and women 2019-26 already, women 2013-18 to compute from Stage 0; main-tour box-score matches 2025: M 2,637 / W 2,485; 2026 to 28 Jul: M 1,620 / W 1,502; ~0.50 (M) / 0.25 (W) tiebreaks per match
model_overlap: low (diluted inside elo_overall, elo_games, points_52w; no tiebreak input)
pool_rows: none as a residual (U-207 is Stage 4's raw record, not stored)
prior_evidence: Stage 4 (predictability_diagnostic/stage4_results.csv, seasons 2013-2024 read): raw 52-week tiebreak record beside the close has a negative walk-forward coefficient in 11/11 men's and 12/12 women's seasons, mean OOS gain W +0.09 / M -0.04 mLL; Stage 2: persistence 0.06 vs luck (2010-26 pooled, in-match); pre-repair pipeline: pointers only
exposed_2025_26: partly (weak): Stage 4's text sentence on the tiebreak record given Elo pools 2013-2026; no 2025-26 reading against a price used
notes: Expectation uses the match's own rates (includes tiebreak points: conservative bias toward 0); check calibration by p-bins on 2010-12. Gate: market loading c > 0 (memo section 4). Bundle with PS03, PS04, PS06.

name: Results-rating luck gap (Elo on results minus Elo on points-implied results)
definition: Run stage1_baselines' Elo twice over Stage 0: with the result y, and with Lambda_P substituted for y where a box score exists (logit Lambda_P = beta_tour,bo * (T_i - T_j)/sqrt(T_i + T_j), T = total points won, fitted once on 2010-12). Gap = R(y) - R(Lambda_P) pre-match, in log-odds; a third run with Lambda_G (games-implied) splits it into set luck R(y)-R(Lambda_G) and game luck R(Lambda_G)-R(Lambda_P). Companion decayed sums of y-Lambda_P, y-Lambda_G, Lambda_G-Lambda_P (h 91 d).
mechanism: Measures the luck a results-based rating (the kind openers and the public use) carries now, with Elo's own memory; the close over-rates the lucky if it leans on results
data_paths: data/studies/predictability_diagnostic/stage0_match_players.parquet (spw_n/d, tb_won_n/d, hold_n/d, brk_n/d, bp_saved_n/d, bp_conv_n/d, games_won_n/d, sets_won_n/d, tpw_n/d); stage0_matches.parquet (score, best_of, status, level, round); src/eda/predictability_diagnostic/stage1_baselines.py (Elo pass); src/eda/feature_interactions/features/f18_overreact.py (I-025 reference)
coverage_note: As PS01; every main-tour match with a rated history
model_overlap: medium (elo_overall ~ R(y); ratings_iid points-based; the same-dynamics difference is not formable from them)
pool_rows: U-278 (I-025, 13-week match luck, inside B-OVERREACT U-277); U-015 (games-weighted Elo, not a substituted result)
prior_evidence: B-OVERREACT block incl. I-025: z +2.13 beyond the model / +2.27 beyond the price, 2014-24, both windows positive, never decomposed (feature_interactions/next_candidates.md); Stage 4: luck corrects Elo downward (given Elo)
exposed_2025_26: partly: market_anchoring's men's decayed hold/break luck (uncalibrated iid) read on 2019-2025 (-0.01 [-0.10,+0.09] mLL) and 2026 (+0.28 [-0.07,+0.62]); I-025 itself unseen
notes: I-025's beta*(t-1/2) form as a sensitivity. Expected R2 with the 56 inputs 0.2-0.4 (inferred).

name: Break-point luck in four pieces (saved, faced, converted, chances created)
definition: Per match: save luck S - F*sbar(p_i); faced luck F - G*phibar(p_i); conversion luck C - Ch*(1 - sbar(p_j)); chance luck Ch - G_opp*phibar(p_j); sbar = weighted logistic of saves on logit p, phibar = iid break points per service game (f08_clutch.bp_per_game) times a tour constant, both frozen on 2010-12. Four decayed sums (h 91 d), A - B. Signs: save -, faced +, conversion -, chance -. Hold luck ~ save luck - (1 - sbar)*faced luck.
mechanism: The close credits holds; holding by saving break points (luck, persistence 0.07-0.11) is rated like holding by not facing them (skill, reliability 0.71). Luck reading of the men's serving-over-rated / returning-under-rated lead
data_paths: data/studies/predictability_diagnostic/stage0_match_players.parquet (spw_n/d, tb_won_n/d, hold_n/d, brk_n/d, bp_saved_n/d, bp_conv_n/d, games_won_n/d, sets_won_n/d, tpw_n/d); stage0_matches.parquet (score, best_of, status, level, round); data/studies/predictability_diagnostic/stage2_matches.parquet (bp_save_over_a/_b, naive); src/eda/feature_interactions/features/f08_clutch.py
coverage_note: Hold/break counts in 99.4% (M) / 97.9% (W) of evaluation matches; women's service-game counts 74% of 2013-21
model_overlap: medium-high (form_bp_saved, form_bp_faced_pg, form_bp_conv, form_brk, iosO/D_bp_saved are raw rates = skill + luck)
pool_rows: none stored (market_anchoring's hold/break luck lives in its own table)
prior_evidence: edge_anatomy scan_inputs.csv, eras 2013-24: men's form_bp_saved z -1.35/-0.80/-0.86/-1.68 and form_bp_faced_pg -1.37/-0.42/-1.73/-2.45 beside the close; Stage 4 raw 52-week bp_saved coefficient negative in 11/11 men's seasons and 6/6 women's (2019-24); Stage 2 naive expectation biased (+0.8 pp saves)
exposed_2025_26: partly: motivated in part by edge_anatomy's 2025-26 ledger (men's holds -4.4, bp saved -3.9, two-week bp saved -2.8) and market_anchoring's 2019-2026 hold/break luck readings
notes: Mechanism-separating discovery fit: residuals beside iosO_hold and iosO_bp_saved; luck explains the serving over-rating if residuals take the negative weight and the profile's serve terms go to 0. Highest re-encoding risk of the luck family.

name: Event-run luck and the flattering last scoreline
definition: Run luck R = sum over the player's earlier matches at this event (qualifying included) of (y - Lambda_P); 0 with an indicator if none. Scoreline flattery F = logit(games share) - kappa*logit(points share) of the previous match, kappa the 2010-12 population slope. A - B; signs negative.
mechanism: Within an event the recreational market prices how the last match looked (straight sets, bagels); sharp models price points; a recreational close (BetOnline from Sep 2025) keeps more. Separates rhythm (+, U-138) from luck (-) in a deep run
data_paths: data/studies/predictability_diagnostic/stage0_match_players.parquet (spw_n/d, tb_won_n/d, hold_n/d, brk_n/d, bp_saved_n/d, bp_conv_n/d, games_won_n/d, sets_won_n/d, tpw_n/d); stage0_matches.parquet (score, best_of, status, level, round)
coverage_note: Run luck exists for ~55-57% of main-tour matches (rounds after the first, more with qualifying); both tours, all seasons
model_overlap: low (sets_14d mixes progress and luck; round)
pool_rows: U-280 (I-086, price surprise of the last win: a different quantity), U-138 / U-307 (On)
prior_evidence: None direct; B-OVERREACT block (above) nearest; On z +3.29 (2014-24) is its counterpart
notes: Test beside U-138 and I-086; kill if On's coefficient is unchanged with and without it and run luck >= 0.

name: Serve-speed state extensions (second serve, gap, fault speed, last-match fade)
definition: Each a 14-day mean minus own 364-day mean, per SD, event-year centred: (a) second-serve speed; (b) first-minus-second speed gap; (c) mean speed of first-serve faults minus first serves in; (d) last match's first-serve speed, last third of service points minus first third, against own normal fade, controlled for points played. A - B.
mechanism: Physical state (shoulder, fatigue, confidence) shows in the radar before results; unwatched data (M1); the base first-serve state replicated
data_paths: data/dump/matches/mantennisdata/ (match averages incl. second serve, Oct 2021-); data/studies/serve_speed_tabpfn/live/speed_panel_*.parquet (y, spd2, spd_max, fault1); data/dump/points/infosys_slams/points.parquet (AO25, RG25-26, fault speeds 96-98%); data/raw/public_dump/atp_pipeline_handoff/court_vision/ (2021-24 per serve incl. faults); data/dump/points/slam_ball_tracking/ (AO/RG 2019-24); data/dump/points/{wimbledon,usopen}/
coverage_note: Men only (no free WTA tour speed). (a),(b): tour level ~1,700 matches in 2025 via ManTennisData. (c),(d): per-serve 2021-24 ATP CV (~4,450 linked) + Slams; ATP non-Slam 2025-26 not on disk (package P9, ~10,800 matches, decryption approved)
model_overlap: medium for (a),(b),(d) (spd_L stage 2 is first-serve 28-day form); low for (c)
pool_rows: U-198 (sl__spd2_*, thin before 2022), U-199, U-137 (box-score within-event decay)
prior_evidence: Base first-serve speed change: replication +0.090 [+0.017,+0.162] log-odds/SD given the model, 2022-24 (point_sequence); extensions untested (scout #1)
exposed_2025_26: partly: the family is motivated by the base signal's 2025-26 results (serve_speed_tabpfn, edge_anatomy)
notes: Centring by event-year crosses players: clock + probe.py. Outcome-free gate first: predicts next-match first-serve points won beyond spd_L (<= 2024).

name: Close-set and deciding-set luck
definition: Close-set luck: over sets that reached 5-5 (7-5, 5-7, 7-6, 6-7, long advantage sets), sets won minus sum of pi_55(p_i, p_j), the iid probability of winning a set from 5-5 averaged over both serving orders (includes the tiebreak). Deciding-set luck: deciding sets won minus pi_set(p_i, p_j, rule). Decayed sums, A - B, negative.
mechanism: Close and deciding sets are near coin flips under iid but read as toughness or fitness; results and rankings carry them
data_paths: data/studies/predictability_diagnostic/stage0_match_players.parquet (spw_n/d, tb_won_n/d, hold_n/d, brk_n/d, bp_saved_n/d, bp_conv_n/d, games_won_n/d, sets_won_n/d, tpw_n/d); stage0_matches.parquet (score, best_of, status, level, round); src/eda/predictability_diagnostic/stage2_iid.py (set_win, tiebreak, deciding_set_rule)
coverage_note: As PS01; set scores from the score string
pool_rows: U-207 (Stage 4 raw deciding-set record, not stored)
prior_evidence: Stage 4 seasons 2013-2024: women's raw 52-week deciding-set record negative beside the close in 11/12 seasons; men's mixed; persistence of tiebreak over-performance 0.06 (Stage 2)
exposed_2025_26: partly (weak): as PS01 (Stage 4 pooled given-Elo text)
notes: Overlaps PS01 (tiebreaks are a subset of close sets): pre-register PS01 and the 7-5 remainder separately.

name: Ranking-points luck
definition: Over the 52-week ranking window: sum of (y_k - Lambda_P,k) * dRP_k, dRP = ranking points for reaching the next round at match k's level and year (official tables), divided by the player's current ranking points; A - B; negative.
mechanism: Rankings drive seeding, the public's anchor and rank-based openers; luck in big-event rounds inflates them more than Elo
data_paths: data/studies/predictability_diagnostic/stage0_match_players.parquet (spw_n/d, tb_won_n/d, hold_n/d, brk_n/d, bp_saved_n/d, bp_conv_n/d, games_won_n/d, sets_won_n/d, tpw_n/d); stage0_matches.parquet (score, best_of, status, level, round) (rank_points); ATP and WTA ranking-points tables by year (to transcribe)
coverage_note: Both tours; needs the points tables (public, small, hand-made)
model_overlap: low (points_52w is the actual points, not their luck share)
prior_evidence: None direct; Stage 4: ranking one of few positives beyond the close for women (pre-repair)
notes: Visibility-weighted variant of PS02; also a level-weighted decayed sum as a cheaper proxy.

name: Games-route minus points-route rating matchup, luck direction (I-009 re-framed)
definition: z_C2 - z_C1: match log-odds from the surface IOS hold ratings (via serve_rate_for_hold) minus from the spw IOS, remainder after projection on the inputs (f08_clutch.x_i009); registered NEGATIVE (luck), not + (skill).
mechanism: Long-memory hold/break records beyond what points imply are mostly luck; the close credits holds
data_paths: src/eda/feature_interactions/features/f08_clutch.py (x_i009); feature_interactions panel; surface IOS (U-069 for spw)
coverage_note: Model frame, both tours, 2013-26 (code exists)
model_overlap: medium (iosO/D_hold in model; spw IOS not)
prior_evidence: Dropped before screening by a skill reliability gate (split-half 0.16 M / 0.27 W, 2010-18); never screened
notes: Cheapest to test; uses the leak-proof IOS (probe already passed for the inputs).

name: Women's error state (WTA advanced statistics)
definition: Unforced errors per point played in the last 14 days minus the player's own 52-week rate, event-year centred, per SD; A - B; sign negative (rising errors = declining state).
mechanism: Confidence or physical decline shows in errors before results; no market watches this feed
data_paths: data/dump/points/wta/advanced/<year>.parquet (2022-24 totals; 2025-26 full detail)
coverage_note: Women, WTA tour and 125 levels; UE totals 91-92% filled 2022-24 (~3.6-4.2k singles/yr), 97.5% in 2025; no Slams

prior_evidence: Error rates closed as traits (shot_level); never built as a state (scout #9)
notes: Only three discovery seasons; error crediting by stats crews may shift by event-year.

name: Return elasticity to server strength (non-additive matchup)
definition: Per returner, shrunk slope of match return-point residuals (logit rpw minus IOS-predicted from the server's pre-match O and the returner's D) on the server's O; matchup term b_A*(O_B - Obar) - b_B*(O_A - Obar).
mechanism: Additive serve/return models (bookmakers' and ours) miss returners who hold up against big servers
data_paths: data/studies/predictability_diagnostic/stage0_match_players.parquet (spw_n/d, tb_won_n/d, hold_n/d, brk_n/d, bp_saved_n/d, bp_conv_n/d, games_won_n/d, sets_won_n/d, tpw_n/d); stage0_matches.parquet (score, best_of, status, level, round); leak-proof surface IOS (src/eda/match_timing/ios_time.py run_timed)
coverage_note: Both tours, all levels with box scores
pool_rows: U-098 (opponent-strength splits, closed), U-324 (B4 style cells, gate-dropped)
prior_evidence: Related splits failed reliability gates; reliability gate first
exposed_2025_26: partly: motivated by edge_anatomy's 2025-26 men's serving/returning asymmetry
notes: The structural alternative to PS03's luck reading of the serve/return lead.

name: Visible luck count: points-dominant losses minus fewer-points wins, last 10 matches
definition: Count of the last 10 matches lost while winning more total points, minus those won with fewer points; A - B; sign positive (unlucky = under-rated).
mechanism: The market sees the W/L column; points say otherwise
data_paths: data/studies/predictability_diagnostic/stage0_match_players.parquet (spw_n/d, tb_won_n/d, hold_n/d, brk_n/d, bp_saved_n/d, bp_conv_n/d, games_won_n/d, sets_won_n/d, tpw_n/d); stage0_matches.parquet (score, best_of, status, level, round)
coverage_note: Both tours, all seasons
prior_evidence: 4.36% (M) / 3.86% (W) of matches go to the player with fewer points (Stage 2)
notes: Short-memory, discrete form of PS02; likely dominated by it.

name: Cheap-wins share
definition: Share of the last 52 weeks' wins that came by opponent retirement or walkover (status); A - B; negative.
mechanism: Rankings and results-based ratings count them fully
data_paths: data/studies/predictability_diagnostic/stage0_matches.parquet (status, status_detail)
coverage_note: All levels
prior_evidence: none found
notes: Rare; mostly a check of whether the model's Elo counts retirements.

name: Escapes: match points saved in recent matches
definition: Match points saved (score replay) in matches won over the last 8 weeks, minus match points failed to convert in losses; A - B; negative.
mechanism: A narrative of resilience the public pays for; under iid it is luck
data_paths: data/studies/point_sequence/sequences.parquet (set_no, game_no, pt_no, server, winner; score replays)
coverage_note: Model-frame coverage 87-98% (men 66,300 usable matches 2013-24; 2025: M 4,293 / W 5,122); predates later sources
prior_evidence: Big-point traits closed (point_sequence); escapes as luck untested
notes: Rare event; fold into PS04 if built.

name: Luck exposure as a price-slope modulator
definition: Sum over both players' recent tiebreaks and close sets of pi(1 - pi) (outcome-free luck variance), times the close's log-odds; context modulator.
mechanism: Noisy records deserve more shrinkage; the close may not shrink enough
data_paths: data/studies/predictability_diagnostic/stage0_match_players.parquet (spw_n/d, tb_won_n/d, hold_n/d, brk_n/d, bp_saved_n/d, bp_conv_n/d, games_won_n/d, sets_won_n/d, tpw_n/d); stage0_matches.parquet (score, best_of, status, level, round)
coverage_note: All
prior_evidence: none found
notes: Price-slope rule: enters only beside odds_logit (feature_universe section 6, item 4).
